findings.title: Open vSwitch forwarded-SKB page-cache LPE
findings.description:
Kernel 7.0.12-linuxkit is in an upstream affected range; vendor backports may override this result
Open vSwitch kernel datapath: built-in and reachable
OVS generic-netlink support: inferred enabled
ESP in-place-decryption consumer: reachable (esp4: built-in; esp6: built-in)
XFRM userspace state configuration: built-in and reachable
Unprivileged user namespaces: enabled (namespace CAP_NET_ADMIN is obtainable)
POTENTIAL ROOT LPE: the affected kernel range and all known OVS/ESP/userns/setuid prerequisites were detected
Confirm the running distribution kernel contains all three vendor backports before treating as vulnerable
Mitigation: update the vendor kernel; if unused, hard-disable openvswitch (or esp4/esp6) with an install /bin/false rule
